real_source_witnesses.source_sentence: Bush married Laura Welch , an elementary school librarian, in 1977.
As governor , Bush sponsored tort reform legislation, increased funding for education, set higher standards for schools, and reformed the criminal justice system.
He also ordered the 2003 invasion of Iraq to overthrow Saddam Hussein 's regime, citing claims that it possessed weapons of mass destruction and had ties with al-Qaeda .

Presidency (2001–2009)

Bush had originally outlined an ambitious domestic agenda, but his priorities were significantly altered following the September 11 attacks .
